messages:
Maya Patel: quick FYI 1: did a small bring-up of q4b->int4 on the qbringup branch and the summarization promptset has a cluster of regressions. uploaded a slice to gs://redwood-curation/tmp/silo-B-2026-03-21.jsonl. thinking of isolating into relabel queue 'silo-B' so main bank stays clean. objections? :thinking_face:

Soren Li: can you paste two representative failures? want to check if it's hallucination, truncation, or tokenization drift before we route to labeling.

Maya Patel: pasted two short examples (trimmed):
```
{id: "xyz001", prompt: "Summarize:
- alpha
- beta", expected: "List alpha and beta", q4b: "alpha and beta", int4: "alpha"}
{id: "xyz002", prompt: "Steps:
1) start
2) finish", expected: "start then finish", q4b: "start then finish", int4: "start then finish but missing detail"}
```
seems like trailing list/suffix truncation in many cases.

Priya Rao: before we create relabel work, run dedupe with fuzzyhash v2; last time we relabeled duplicates and burned golden credits. command: `python -m curation.tools.dedupe --bank silo-B --fuzzy v2`

Maya Patel: running dedupe now. tagging @Jorge Martinez for labeler capacity 1: rough estimate 220 items after dedupe, ~50h of labeler time at normal cadence.

Jorge Martinez: i can allocate 2 labelers tomorrow afternoon and 1 senior for QC spot checks. what's the QC criteria? want to avoid subjective rewrites becoming gold.

Priya Rao: QC rules: require 3-annotator agreement OR match to golden_set/v5 anchor. if >30% disagreement escalate to senior curation. also add a tokenizer-check step: if tokenization v1->v2 mismatch present, convert prompt to v2 canonicalization before labeling.

qc-bot: QC check queued 4312345685 for gs://redwood-curation/tmp/silo-B-2026-03-21.jsonl (golden-compare + tokenizer-diff)

Maya Patel: dedupe finished -> 197 unique items. staging micro-golden relabel job now with golden_set/v5 anchors, tokenizer conversion applied where needed. also kicking off a hosted canary eval: `curl https://api.redwood.com/v1/bench -d '{"model":"q4b-int4-canary","dataset":"silo-B-sample"}'` will post results when ready.

Soren Li: add a short automated post-label check: run the canary on new golds and compare token-length distribution. if median output tokens shorter by >15% flag for engineering triage. we've seen quant kernels drop trailing n-grams.

Maya Patel: good call. will add that to the pipeline. will drop relabel task link when ready. thanks :thumbsup:
